_note: Candidate registry for Mississippi 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Mississippi Secretary of State, SAMPLE Official Election Ballot, State of Mississippi, Federal and Judicial Election, Tuesday, November 3, 2026 (file dated 9-9-26), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Mississippi Secretary of State, SAMPLE Official Election Ballot, State of Mississippi, Federal and Judicial Election, Tuesday, November 3, 2026 (file dated 9-9-26) (https://www.sos.ms.gov/content/documents/Elections/2026/Sample%20Ballot%209-9-26.pdf); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
